name: pace
text: A person slowly paces back and forth, walking along a short straight path, turning around at each end. Arms relaxed. Return to the initial position and facing direction.

review.notes_zh: 短距离往返踱步，两端转身，回到起点和原朝向；按1.5米路径全身关键帧重生成，实际根路径纵向范围1.65米，端点同姿态。
